mainEntity.name: Is hosting.com the same as A2 Hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A2 Hosting said on its own blog in April 2025 that it was now hosting.com.
Starter is $1.49 a month on a 12-month plan and renews at $13.99 a month. Pro is $3.49 and Max is $5.99 on sale.
CNET says no and calls setup overly complicated. HostingAdvice found live chat fast, so test support early.
HostingAdvice measured a Largest Contentful Paint of 579 ms on the cheap plan and an A grade on WordPress hosting.
